authorization: Current user, tenant/project/private-task and available source authorization; manual writes also require project write permission. Idempotent replay reauthorizes. Admin requires its existing scoped capabilities.
manual_edit: Completed cloud execute tasks only. UTF-8 up to 256 KiB. New immutable asset version under task version, delivery hash and original file hash locks. No model request, task creation or AI fee.
cloud_execution_query: GET software-checks accepts view=all|terminal|browser. Filtering precedes pagination and applies to its cursor lookup.
